map.内部培训算学时吗？: Do internal training sessions count toward hours?
map.经认定的内训、线上课多可计入，需保留签到与时长记录作为凭证。: Recognised internal training and online courses usually count, but sign-in sheets and duration records must be kept as evidence.
map.超要求能结转吗？: Can surplus hours be carried over?
map.多数企业不结转，当年有效，少数可转下年部分额度，看制度。: Most companies do not carry them over, so they are valid within the year; a few allow part of the quota to roll into the next year, which depends on policy.
